source_review_scope: Read-only issue metadata and reported diagnostics, not executed reproductions.
security_scope: Review holds are not confirmed security vulnerabilities.

etcd-io--etcd--22264.reason: The report describes a growing MVCC recovery scan holding the watcher-store lock while writes wait. Keep the backlog/resource-availability workload on hold. No historical-revision load, cluster, fault or supplied program was run.
etcd-io--etcd--22264.reason_zh: 报告描述落后 watcher 的 MVCC 恢复扫描随积压增长，长时间持有锁并阻塞写入。按积压与可用性场景暂缓；未制造历史修订积压、启动集群、注入故障或执行附带程序。

etcd-io--etcd--22184.reason: The report gives a three-goroutine lock-order cycle that permanently wedges the apply loop. Keep the deadlock/snapshot-send scenario on hold. No lock-cycle workload, snapshot, cluster or supplied test was run.
etcd-io--etcd--22184.reason_zh: 报告给出三个 goroutine 形成的锁序环，可能永久卡住 apply loop。按死锁与快照发送场景暂缓；未运行锁环工作负载、快照、集群或附带测试。

etcd-io--etcd--22744.reason: The report describes process termination when the raft stream decoder receives malformed protobuf. Keep malformed-input and process-termination execution on hold; impact unassessed. No stream input, packet, decoder test, server or supplied program was executed.
etcd-io--etcd--22744.reason_zh: 报告描述 raft 流解码器遇到畸形 protobuf 时可能终止整个进程。按畸形输入与进程终止线索暂缓，影响未评估；未发送报文、运行解码器测试、启动服务或执行附带程序。

etcd-io--etcd--22225.reason: The benchmark starts its timer after receiving a WatchResponse, so its measurement endpoint is different from Put-to-Watch latency. Source review establishes a metric-definition problem, not a missing historical caller or an independently verified CoroPerf fact. No benchmark or cluster was run.
etcd-io--etcd--22225.reason_zh: 该 benchmark 在收到 WatchResponse 后才开始计时，与 Put-to-Watch 延迟的测量端点不同。源码审阅确认的是指标定义问题，尚未建立历史调用者缺口或独立验证的 coroPerf 新增事实；未运行 benchmark 或集群。

tikv--tikv--6973.reason: The report concerns thread-local PerfContext statistics across split tasks. The linked explicit !Send change was later reverted; closure alone does not establish a correct released implementation. Retain for native counter/slow-log comparison, with no runtime, fix or CoroPerf attribution result yet.
tikv--tikv--6973.reason_zh: 报告涉及任务分段、跨线程时的线程本地 PerfContext 统计。关联的显式 !Send 改动后来被回退，不能仅凭关闭状态判定发行版正确。保留原生计数器/慢日志对照候选；尚无运行、修复或 coroPerf 归属结果。

tikv--tikv--20204.reason: The report supplies a finite empty-range cooperative-yield comparison and links a fix. Retain for a real TiKV request/native profiling comparison; a standalone reimplementation would not verify the framework behavior. No endpoint test, binary build, TiKV process or CoroPerf result is claimed.
tikv--tikv--20204.reason_zh: 报告给出有限空范围请求的协作让出对照，并关联修复。保留实际 TiKV 请求与原生 profiling 对照候选；独立重写算法不能验证框架行为。尚未执行 endpoint 测试、构建二进制、启动 TiKV 或取得 coroPerf 结果。

cloud_reporting.scope: Enabled configuration and a successful local web report are not proof of a cloud task run or user notification receipt. No duplicate schedule created.
